related_questions.question: What foods are allowed on the Budwig diet?
related_questions.snippet: The Budwig Diet is an unproven anticancer treatment developed by the German biochemist Dr. Johanna Budwig in the 1950s. The diet consists of multiple daily servings of flaxseed oil and cottage cheese, as well as vegetables, fruits and juices. Processed foods, meats, most dairy products and sugar are prohibited.
related_questions.title: Budwig Diet | Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center

related_questions.question: What is Budwig's recipe?
related_questions.snippet: The Budwig blend is a 2:1 ratio of low-fat organic cottage cheese or quark to flaxseed (linseed) oil. For example, you could blend 6 tablespoons of cottage cheese or quark with 3 tablespoons of flaxseed oil and enough water to give it a soft, custard-like consistency. An alternative to the blend is the Budwig 'muesli'.

related_questions.question: How do you make Budwig with flaxseed oil and cottage cheese?

text_blocks.snippet: The Budwig protocol centers around a blend of low-fat cottage cheese or quark and flaxseed oil, designed to improve the absorption of omega-3 fatty acids. This combination is typically made with a 2:1 ratio of cottage cheese to flaxseed oil, and it's recommended to be consumed within 20 minutes of preparation to prevent oxidation. Other variations may include ground flaxseeds, fruits, nuts, and honey.

list.snippet: Ratio: Use 2 parts low-fat cottage cheese or quark to 1 part flaxseed oil.
Example: Blend 6 tablespoons of cottage cheese with 3 tablespoons of flaxseed oil.
Consistency: Add a little water or low-fat milk to achieve a custard-like consistency.
Ground Flaxseeds: If using ground flaxseeds, a common ratio is 1 tablespoon of ground flaxseeds to 2 tablespoons of cottage cheese.
Additions: Consider adding honey, chopped fresh fruit, and/or nuts for flavor and added nutrients.
Consume Quickly: The mixture should be consumed within 20 minutes of preparation.

list.title: Freshness:
list.snippet: The Budwig diet emphasizes the importance of using fresh, high-quality ingredients.

list.title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids:
list.snippet: Flaxseed oil is rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which are believed to be important for cellular health.

list.title: Potential Benefits:
list.snippet: The Budwig diet is based on the idea that this combination improves oxygen uptake by cell membranes and has potential benefits for cancer prevention and treatment.

list.title: No Scientific Consensus:
list.snippet: While proponents of the Budwig diet claim various benefits, it's important to note that there is no scientific consensus on its effectiveness for treating or preventing cancer.

list.title: Possible Side Effects:
list.snippet: Some people may experience gastrointestinal issues like gas, bloating, or constipation when consuming flaxseed.

list.title: Consult a Doctor:
list.snippet: Individuals with specific health conditions or concerns should consult with their doctor before starting any new dietary regimen.
